visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright studio setting with a solid pink background, a woman with long, vibrant red hair and a crisp white suit jacket leans forward, resting her arms on an unseen surface. She smiles warmly at the camera. Golden Chinese ingot graphics float around her, and stylized 'New Year' text is visible at the top. (2) The scene transitions to the same woman wearing a dark maroon blazer against a deep red and pink gradient backdrop. She sits with her hand supporting her chin, looking directly into the lens with a focused, serious expression. Large golden Chinese characters and 'HAPPY NEW YEAR' slogans appear on screen. (3) The woman appears in a side profile view, dressed in a white suit. She is framed against a pink background featuring a large, solid red circular graphic. Her hair is styled loosely, and she maintains a poised, calm demeanor. Large red and gold text '大吉大利' is overlaid at the bottom. (4) The visual shifts to live footage of the woman on a stage, holding a black microphone in her right hand and gesturing with her left. She wears a white outfit and gold bracelets. Playful cartoon emojis, including bears, mice, and hearts, are animated to float around her head against a white background. (5) In the concluding segment, she is shown in a beige blazer against a minimalist grey background. The frame is filled with colorful digital drawings of stars, fireworks, and abstract scribbles. She gazes off-camera thoughtfully before looking back. Text thanking 2024 and welcoming 2025 is prominently displayed.

The female vocals transition through a rhythmic bridge, maintaining a high pitch and consistent volume. There are no external sound effects or speech; the mix is entirely dedicated to the BGM track which possesses a very positive emotional valence. The singer's final notes are sustained with a clear, harmonic resonance.
